items.title: Eli Lilly inks cancer pact worth up to $5.9bn with Stipple Bio
items.summary: Stipple plans to initiate a Phase I trial for an ADC for solid tumours in early 2027.

items.title: Pfizer CEO: ‘China will be my major competition by 2030’
items.summary: Pfizer CEO Albert Bourla’s comments come a month after the Chinese government unveiled a five-year biomedical plan to grow its pharma exports.

items.title: Seawolf Therapeutics and Sanofi agree $1.2bn drug deal
items.summary: Seawolf Therapeutics and Sanofi have signed a multi-target research partnership and exclusive licensing deal worth up to $1.2bn to develop treatments for bleeding disorders and other undisclosed indications.

items.title: UK biotech sector calls on government to support sector’s growth on home soil
items.summary: UK biotech organisations outline their needs to the British government to scale, manufacture and commercialise biological products.

items.title: Lilly agrees to acquire Calytrix Bio for $1.5bn
items.summary: Eli Lilly and Company has agreed to acquire Calytrix Bio in a deal valued at up to $1.5bn to advance an investigational biparatopic antibody targeting mCALR-driven ET and MF.
